case_level_notes: Core failure: CRA did not forward primary source documents to the furnisher and relied on automated coding, while dispositive consumer evidence (settlement) conflicted with verified balance. Human review required.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Dispute components are described in the narrative.

material_facts.fact: Consumer disputed charged-off balance with bank statements and creditor letter

determinations.rationale: Consumer submitted a dispute identifying the account, disputed field (charged-off balance), and basis (settlement payment) with supporting documents.

material_facts.fact: CRA received and coded the dispute

determinations.rationale: Valid trigger received by CRA with no frivolous determination noted.
CRA completed within 29 days, within the 30-day window.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Failure to forward relevant documents is explicitly stated.

material_facts.fact: Generic code sent; document images not sent or made available

determinations.rationale: CRA notified furnisher on day 4 (timely), but sent only a generic 'claims paid' code and did not forward primary documents (bank statements/creditor letter), so the notice did not include all relevant information.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Explicit facts show reasonableness duties unmet.
determinations.rationale: CRA relied on automated coding only, did not consider primary source documents, and dispositive consumer info was ignored despite conflicting documents.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Drawn from explicit conflicting evidence in record.
determinations.rationale: Item was verified as accurate, but verification rested on an unreasonable reinvestigation that ignored dispositive primary documents, so treatment is not properly supported.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Avoids asserting full compliance absent specific disclosure facts.
determinations.rationale: Narrative indicates a timely results notice was sent, but the packet does not affirm all required disclosures (procedure description right, furnisher contact, consumer statement right, notification right) beyond the default binding.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Not applicable since no termination invoked.
determinations.rationale: No frivolous termination was made; provision is not applicable.

material_facts.fact: Item verified, not deleted or reinserted

determinations.rationale: No deletion or reinsertion occurred; provision not applicable.
No reseller involvement indicated; not applicable.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Furnisher duty to review all info provided cannot be met when info wasn't provided; verification outcome reflects this gap.

material_facts.fact: Primary documents not forwarded to furnisher
Furnisher verified old balance despite consumer's settlement evidence

determinations.rationale: Furnisher could not review all relevant information because the CRA did not forward primary documents; verification of the old balance despite settlement documents indicates inadequate investigation of available info.
No direct dispute to furnisher in this case; not applicable.
No consumer statement filed; provision not applicable.
Manual review policy trigger flagged, conflicting consumer/furnisher documents exist, and primary documents were not considered—human review is required.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Non-compliance grounded in explicit record facts.

material_facts.fact: Automated code only / dispositive info ignored

determinations.rationale: Multiple obligations failed: furnisher notice lacked relevant primary documents, CRA consideration was inadequate (automated code only, dispositive info ignored), and item treatment is not supported.
